item.title: RACER Weekly: The new era of American rallying
item.description: In this episode of RACER Weekly, we’re joined by ARA Series Manager Preston Osborn to break down the state of rallying in the USA – from the drama of the season-opening Snowdrift Rally to the bigger picture of where the championship is heading.

item.description: Racing America has announced that Mission Foods is extending its partnership, continuing its designation as the Official Tortillas, Wraps, Flatbreads and Tortilla Chips of Racing America. item.title: Herbst taking the rough with the smooth as he puts wild Daytona finish behind him
item.description: As it always does, the Daytona 500 went right down to the bitter end last Sunday and Riley Herbst in the No. 35 Monster Energy Toyota was smack in the middle of the multi-car fray headed towards the checkered flag.

item.title: Camara ends second day of F2 pre-season testing fastest for Invicta Racing
item.description: Rafael Camara set the fastest time of the Formula 2 pre-season test in Barcelona so far, recording a 1m23.630s in Wednesday's morning session for Invicta Racing. The Brazilian was just 0.018s faster than Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak and ART Grand Prix, with Alexander Dunne in third for Rodin Motorsport.In the afternoon, it...

item.title: Rossi leads morning session on Day 2 of IndyCar testing at Phoenix
item.description: Ed Carpenter Racing’s Alexander Rossi was quick from the outset Wednesday morning at the Unser IndyCar Open Test at Phoenix Raceway, producing his best lap in the No. 20 Ed Carpenter Racing Chevy on his fifth tour of the one-mile oval, at 174.444mph.

item.title: Driver’s Eye views set for all IndyCar races in ’26
item.description: FOX Sports debuted its Driver’s Eye in-car helmet camera system and used the unique view at select races during its first season of IndyCar Series coverage, and in an expansion of the program for 2026, it will become a standard feature throughout the 18-race calendar.

item.title: Russell tops Piastri, more Aston issues as final F1 pre-season test begins
item.description: George Russell set the fastest time of the opening day of the final test in Bahrain by just 0.010s ahead of Oscar Piastri, as Aston Martin again had limited track time.

item.title: Superspeedway fuel-saving is still a thorn in the side for the NASCAR field. Is there a fix?
item.description: Denny Hamlin has a thought on how to stop Cup Series teams from playing superspeedway fuel-saving games, but it's important to note that, for now at least, it's only an idea.
